headings.foundational_route_available: A relevant foundational route is available
headings.attention_wm_route_available: A relevant attention and working-memory route is available
headings.verification_route_available: An evidence-informed verification route is available
headings.reentry_route_available: A cognitive-support and workflow re-entry route is available

workflow_explanations.individual_focus_under_competing_informa: Focused work requires relevant information to remain selected while competing input is resisted. The current route targets foundational signal control and uses separate attention measures to examine change.
workflow_explanations.professional_multi_source_synthesis_v1: Multi-source synthesis requires sustained selection, maintenance of comparisons and accurate source-context binding while a coherent account is built.
workflow_explanations.report_review_and_verification_v1: Review and verification require relevant claims to be selected, kept attached to their sources and checked before a sufficiently supported release decision is made.
workflow_explanations.complex_task_reentry_v1: Complex-task re-entry requires the goal, current stage, unresolved relations and source context to be reconstructed after interruption or delay.
workflow_explanations.higher_education_source_synthesis_v1: Evidence-based assignments require learners to sustain attention, preserve comparisons among claims and keep each claim attached to its source and context.
workflow_explanations.objective_cognitive_progress_tracking_v1: A measurement-first route establishes a baseline, repeats separate measures after a defined interval and interprets change with practice effects and uncertainty in view.

coming_soon_labels.wm_relational_calibration: Relational Memory Predictive Calibration — coming soon
coming_soon_labels.wm_binding_calibration: Binding Memory Predictive Calibration — coming soon

coming_soon_explanations.attention_evidence: The planned Evidence Control mode will add sequential evidence accumulation and adaptation when reliability changes.
coming_soon_explanations.attention_calibration: Predictive Calibration will be a derived profile showing whether confidence and updating track evidence quality.
coming_soon_explanations.attention_commit: Decision Timing will test proportionate stopping under changing evidence, time, cost and risk.
coming_soon_explanations.reasoning_evidence: The planned Reasoning Evidence mode will evaluate arguments, alternatives and disconfirming evidence sequentially.
coming_soon_explanations.reasoning_calibration: Belief Calibration will test whether confidence is proportionate to validity and evidence quality.
coming_soon_explanations.reasoning_commit: Reasoning Commit will distinguish accept, reject, defer and test decisions under uncertainty.
coming_soon_explanations.path_signal: Path Prediction will train discrimination among expected, rare, blocked and invalid transitions.

evidence_boundaries.focus_everyday_not_established: Attention Coach targets controlled signal extraction under visual interference. Consistent improvement in sustained everyday focus has not yet been established.
evidence_boundaries.synthesis_workflow_effect_not_establishe: The current apps target relevant attention, relational-memory and binding-memory operations. Improvement in professional synthesis quality has not yet been established.
evidence_boundaries.verification_effect_not_established: The current apps target relevant foundational attention and binding functions. Direct improvement in report or AI-output verification has not yet been established.
evidence_boundaries.reentry_effect_not_established: Training may address relevant foundational functions, but interruption control and visible task state should be tested alongside it. Faster real-work re-entry has not yet been established.
evidence_boundaries.education_outcome_not_established: The route provides non-clinical cognitive practice and separate measurement. It does not guarantee assignment, examination or grade improvement.
evidence_boundaries.change_not_broad_proof: A baseline-to-follow-up difference is not by itself proof of broad cognitive improvement; practice effects, measurement uncertainty and comparable testing conditions must be considered.

global_product_status.approved_public_statement: G Track, Attention Coach Signal and WM Coach Signal are available now. Evidence, calibration, commitment, path-prediction and explicit-reasoning modules are coming soon and remain under staged development and validation.
